text: Which boutique luxury real estate agencies in Australia are best known for modern social media marketing, high-impact video campaigns, and architectural homes?

result.keyword: Which boutique luxury real estate agencies in Australia are best known for modern social media marketing, high-impact video campaigns, and architectural homes?

items.markdown:
Australia has a dynamic segment of independent and boutique agencies that leverage cinematic walkthroughs, targeted social channels, and high-end digital branding specifically for architectural and design-forward properties.

### Standout Boutique & Prestige Agencies

- **Modern House Estate Agents** : Widely recognized as Australia's premier niche agency exclusively handling Modernist, mid-century, and contemporary architect-designed homes. Their digital presence and curation focus entirely on clean architectural lines, spatial design, and targeted storytelling rather than standard volume listing.[[1]](https://www.modernhouse.co/)
- **Abercrombys Real Estate** : Operating prominently out of Melbourne (with recent interstate growth), they blend a conservative, high-end heritage with a refined digital and video strategy that highlights premium Victorian, modernist, and cutting-end contemporary architectural properties.[[1]](https://luxurylist.com.au/agencies)
- **Ray White Collective Luxury** : Launched by leading prestige specialist Matt Lancashire in Brisbane, this specialized high-end offshoot is built explicitly for ultra-luxury ($4M+) and architecturally striking homes, utilizing modern digital campaigns and high-production video assets to reach national and international buyers.[[1]](https://luxurylist.com.au/agencies)
- **The Boutique Property Co. / Local Independent Prestige Boutiques** : Across Sydney’s eastern suburbs, Byron Bay, and Melbourne’s inner-pockets, specialized independent local operators lean heavily on high-impact cinematic video tours (often partnering with production groups like *Urban Angles* or *REZ Studio* ) to market bespoke residential architecture directly via Instagram and targeted programmatic social feeds.[[1]](https://www.urbanangles.com/)[[2]](https://revenuebase.ai/companies/luxury-real-estate-marketing-agencies/australia/melbourne)
